ItemID: 1; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful for messy workshop cleanup, though I would check chemical compatibility before using them with epoxy.
ItemID: 2; Title: VENLAB Digital Clamp Meter 1000A T-RMS 6000 Counts AC/DC Current Multimeter, Voltage Tester with Auto-ranging Backlight, Measures Voltage Temperature Capacitance Resistance Frequency Continuity NCV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for electrical troubleshooting alongside my inspection and measurement tools.
ItemID: 3; Title: 4-40 and 6-32 Machine Screws, Nuts and Washer 280 pcs Pan Head Screws #4-40#6-32 - Screws Nuts and Washers Set - Full Thread Small Screws with Storage Box; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Small imperial machine screws would complement my metric hardware and help with repairs involving threaded parts.
ItemID: 4; Title: SOOQOO 50 Pcs KN95 Face Maks for Audlts; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on workshop supplies and have no immediate need for this pack of face masks.
ItemID: 5; Title: Touchless Trash Can,3.2 Gallon Waterproof Automatic Smart Bathroom Garbage Can with Lid, Slim Motion Sensor Plastic Narrow Trash Bin for Bedroom, Kitchen, Office,RV White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A small automatic household bin does not address my current fabrication or repair needs.
ItemID: 6; Title: Dong7Niu Endoscope Camera with Light, 2.4 "IPS HD Screen Borescope Inspection Camera, IP67 Waterproof Home Sewer Camera, Snake Camera with 16.5FT Semi-Rigid Cable; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a triple-lens inspection camera with a larger screen, so I would skip another similar scope.
ItemID: 7; Title: ELOOGAA 3Pcs Solderless Breadboard 830 Point Solderless Prototype PCB Board Kit for Arduino Proto Shield Distribution Connecting Blocks; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects involve fastening and fabrication; I do not currently have a circuit-prototyping project.
ItemID: 8; Title: Decibel Meter, CURCONSA SPL Meter, Portable Sound Level Meter, 30dB to 130dB, LCD Display, can be Used in Homes, Factories and Streets(Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like practical measuring tools, but I have no specific noise-measurement task to justify this purchase now.
ItemID: 9; Title: 100 Pc 6"x.045"x7/8" Cut-Off Wheels Lincoln Abrasives Metal & Stainless Steel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent cutting wheels were five-inch; I would not buy a bulk pack of six-inch wheels without confirming tool compatibility.
ItemID: 10; Title: JROUTH 1500pcs Screws Assortment Hex Socket Flat Head Black Screws Nuts and Bolts, M2 M3 M4 M5 10.9 Grade Alloy Steel Hex Flat Head Cap Bolts Nuts Washers Assortment Kit with Hex Wrenches; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The flat-head screws would be useful for flush-mounted assemblies, adding a practical option alongside my existing metric fasteners.
